messages:
Olivia C: Quick heads-up — supply windows shifted for H100/H200 in EU and MI300 carrier ETA in NA. Need a joint plan for marketplace publish + SI enablement.
Diego R: Thanks. Are these inventory delays only or any driver/firmware issues?
NVIDIA - Sunil: H200 racks delayed ~11 days due to customs backlog in EU. No firmware change. We can proceed with a soft-window announce that calls out region availability. Partners request a 48h prebrief.
AMD - Yuna: MI300 carriers bumped ~6 days because of a sorter issue. We also pushed a minor thermal firmware patch this morning; no regressions in our tests so far.
SI - BlueWave: Integrators prefer an SI-GA that starts 2 weeks after public marketplace enablement so we have time to validate images. Could you stagger the SI onboarding?
Infra - Priya: Impact: Gaudi kernel regen ~24h, cross-region canaries ~30-36h. If firmware lands today we can keep current publish week, otherwise we slide by one calendar week. Current canary snapshot:
```
- base-image: rwd-ubuntu-22.04-gpu:2026-03
- kernel: 6.1.55
- cuda: 12.2
- rocm: 5.8
- model-optimizer: 3.2.0
```
Infra - Priya: We'll run NA/EU canaries in parallel; telemetry -> s3://redwood/partnerships/3456789012/canary/
Comms - Alex: Marketing wants a single clean announce. Proposal: publish public marketplace with a "soft availability window" copy and follow up with SI-specific GA two weeks later. Keeps press simple.
Legal - Sam: We'll prepare two copy variants (soft + firm). Need partner approval on partner quotes and 24h for legal review. Tag Legal on the asset PR.
Olivia C: Proposed timeline:
- Day 0: partner prebrief + assets handed off
- Day 1: infra kernel regen + start NA/EU canaries
- Day 3: partner & legal signoff on chosen copy
- Day 4: marketplace publish (gated on canary green)
- Day 18: SI GA (enable integrator enrollments after extra validations)
NVIDIA - Sunil: Sounds good. We ask that perf numbers be labeled "preliminary".
AMD - Yuna: If our patch slips into Day 1, expect a 7-day slip on marketplace enablement. Will notify asap.
SI - BlueWave: We'll schedule our validation window to start Day 6 so integrators have early access to images before GA. That matches our customers' asks.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary-3456789012 -> https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/3456789012/logs
Infra - Priya: Canary running on 4 nodes (2 NA, 1 EU, 1 APAC). Will include latency & memory regressions in the suite.
Infra - Priya: Kernel regen completed for Gaudi; running model-optimizer passes now.
deploy-bot: Canary job completed: status=PASS, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood/partnerships/3456789012/artifacts.tgz
Infra - Priya: Canary PASS. No kernel segfaults. Perf baseline shows B200 peak power +2.4% but within SLO. Uploading full metrics to s3://redwood/partnerships/3456789012/metrics.json
Comms - Alex: Drafted both asset sets. Soft-window copy omits firm ship dates and calls out per-region availability. Firm-date copy ready if partners confirm inventory. Link: https://docs.redwood/announcements/drafts/3456789012
Legal - Sam: Joined review loop. We'll prioritize the soft-window variant to avoid blocking press. Expect legal clearance within 12-24h.
Olivia C: Action items: Priya upload final canary metrics and tag infra ticket INF-7789; Alex circulate soft-window first; Sam watch partner approvals; Diego run partner call tomorrow 11am PT to confirm.
NVIDIA - Sunil: Will be on the call.
AMD - Yuna: Oncall too.
SI - BlueWave: We'll be on the call to confirm SI timeline and image handoff dates.
Olivia C: If partners sign off, marketplace publish Day 4 gated on canary green, SI GA Day 18. If any red flags on the canary or partner approvals, we hold and use soft-window messaging until resolved.
Diego R: Thanks — I'll update the press scheduler tentatively and block the SI enablement window.
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled: partner-handoff-call @ 2026-04-01T11:00:00-07:00
Olivia C: Closing loop for now. Will post minutes after the 11am call. :white_check_mark:
